Tokentrim Dashboard Subscription

You can sign up for a Tokentrim Pro subscription to get a hosted dashboard and other features. The Pro subscription is available for a one-time payment of $49 or $9/month.

How it Works for Pro Subscribers

As a Pro subscriber, you get a hosted dashboard that you can access on any device. You also receive a Monday digest, weekly budget with an alert at 80%, and Slack totals. With a Pro subscription, you can connect up to 3 machines.

What You Get and What it Costs

The Pro lifetime subscription is available for a one-time payment of $49, limited to the first 500 buyers. The Pro monthly subscription is $9/month. Both options provide access to a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, and weekly budget with alert.

FAQ

What are the benefits of a Tokentrim Pro subscription? A Pro subscription gives you access to a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, and other features. How much can I save with Tokentrim? Based on the author's 135 real conversations, Tokentrim cut history re-read by 75% and made limits last 4.0x longer, resulting in a billed cost fall of roughly 55-70%. Is my data secure? By default, nothing leaves your machine.

To get started with Tokentrim, go to the Tokentrim homepage to learn more and sign up for a Pro subscription.
